name: Special Incentive to OBC Meritorious Students (Boys & Girls)
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be currently enrolled as a student. - The applicant must belong to the Other Backward Class (OBC) community of Assam. - The applicant must have secured a minimum of 80% marks in the HSSLC examination held in 2025. - The annual income of the applicant's parents/guardians must not exceed ₹5,00,000/-. _*In instances where multiple applicants achieve an identical percentage in the HSSLC examination, preference will be given to those with a higher percentage in the HSLC examination._
